hero.title: Better procurement.
hero.description: Bring requests, approvals, suppliers, and purchase orders together. Give every purchase a clear path from the first request to the final delivery.
hero.note: Your own organization. Your people. One shared workspace.

platform.title: Less back-and-forth. More moving forward.
platform.description: Keep the details and decisions together, so your team can focus on getting the right things done.

requests.title: Start with a clear request
requests.description: Capture line items, estimates, priorities, and required dates. Follow each requisition through review and approval.

suppliers.title: Build better supplier workflows
suppliers.description: Maintain your supplier directory, invite quotations, compare bids, and record your award decision.

orders.title: Keep orders in view
orders.description: Create purchase orders, track their progress, and see your procurement activity from one dashboard.

workflow.title: A clear next step. Every time.
workflow.description: A straightforward process that connects your team, your suppliers, and your purchasing decisions.

request.title: Define what you need
request.description: Create a requisition with the items, quantities, budget estimates, and timing your team needs.

review.title: Review with confidence
review.description: Move requests through review and approval, with statuses and decisions visible along the way.

source.title: Find the right supplier
source.description: Invite suppliers to quote, compare their bids, and award your request for quotation.

order.title: Turn decisions into orders
order.description: Create a purchase order and track it through approval, supplier acknowledgement, and completion.

roles.title: Clear roles & permissions
roles.description: Give administrators, procurement officers, and viewers the access they need in your organization.

languages.title: English, Arabic & French
languages.description: Work in your preferred language, with a layout that supports right-to-left Arabic.

visibility.title: A shared view of progress
visibility.description: See requisitions, approvals, order activity, and supplier status in one connected workspace.

cta.title: Make room for better procurement.
cta.description: Create an organization, bring your people together, and give your next purchase a clear path.

footer: E-Procurement. Built for the way teams work.

auth.signupPanelTitle: A better way to work, together.
auth.panelDescription: Bring your requests, decisions, and supplier relationships into one organized workspace.
auth.loginDescription: Sign in to keep your procurement moving.
auth.workspaceHint: The workspace ID you chose when creating your organization. Use “default” for the demo workspace.
auth.loginError: We couldn't sign you in. Check your workspace address, email, and password.
auth.loginNote: Joining an existing organization? Ask your administrator to create your account and share its workspace address.
auth.signupEyebrow: A fresh start for your team
auth.signupDescription: Set up your organization and your administrator account.
auth.addressHint: Choose a unique ID: 3–48 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. You'll use it to sign in.
auth.signupNote: You'll become the administrator of a new, separate organization with its own workspace and settings.
auth.addressTaken: This workspace address is already taken. Please choose another.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
auth.signupError: We couldn't create your workspace. Check your details and try again.
